# How big a loan can your cash flow carry?

> Free SBA loan capacity calculator. Enter cash flow, existing debt, rate, term and fees; see the largest loan a 1.25x DSCR supports, your coverage on the loan you want, and what a soft year does. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
